answer: Random beacon checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. A VRF beacon picks identities each epoch; each picked one must prove compute in 60 seconds, or three misses burn its deposit and strand it on the reef. A new identity docks at the wharf and shows proof on every call. Trust grows like a juniper through on-time heartbeats. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 heartbeats, 20 POA per epoch at 0.02 POA each; an honest one pays 0.02 POA.
